endorsements.quote: Frameworks such as the Cross-Industry Standard Process for the development of Machine Learning applications with Quality assurance methodology (CRISP-ML (Q)) 40 can be used to guide organizations in understanding the business case and identify risks for genAI solutions.
Continuous evaluation and monitoring of genAI models are crucial to identify areas for further training and development.

Additionally, considerations for use should include rigorous testing for accuracy and reliability, adherence to privacy and confidentiality standards, and ongoing education for nursing staff about the capabilities and limitations of the AI tools in use.

unlisted_practices: Involve an interdisciplinary team, including nurses, other medical professionals, data scientists, ethicists, and policymakers, in genAI implementation.
Involve nurse informaticists and domain experts in needs assessment, feasibility analysis, implementation, and prompt development for genAI tools.
Conduct a business case and feasibility analysis before implementing genAI solutions.
Use genAI as a supportive tool rather than a decision-maker.

screen.reason: An educational commentary/perspective providing nurses with an understanding and guidance on evaluating and implementing foundation models and generative AI in clinical practice.
